description:
Pick one of the candidates from `design_generate_candidates`.

Pass the `design_id` the USER chose. It binds that design as the active
one and drops the rest; the next `design_chat` continues refining it. Returns
the picked design's `design_url` + `thumbnails` — share them verbatim. With
`thumbnails_pending: true` the preview is still rendering and may not become
available: say so, give the `design_url` so the user can see the design in
the editor, and call `design_status` for the preview later. Do not say that
the preview will appear.

The picked design is ALREADY resolved (`design_resolved: true`) and stays
bound to `order_id` and its item. Do NOT call `order_attach_design`: the payment
link attaches the design of each item. The pick fails with `DesignAttachedError` when the
candidates' item already holds an attached design, and with
`UploadMappingSubmittedError` when that item's uploaded file has a submitted
page mapping. Do not call `order_create_payment_link` unless the customer asked
to pay: the payment link attaches the design and locks the order to it for
good. If they did not ask, show the customer the design and ask whether they
want changes; call `design_chat` if they do.
name: design_pick_candidate

next_step.default: The customer chose this design and can still change it. On an order with several items, the payment link is refused until every item is covered. Each item needs a design or artwork with a submitted page mapping. If they already asked to pay and every item is covered, create the payment link now. If another item is not covered, complete its design or artwork first. If they have not asked to pay, ask whether they want changes. Create the link only when they ask to pay: the link locks each item to its own design.
next_step.description: What to do after the pick.

order_id.description: The order the candidates were generated for. The payment link attaches the picked design to this order.

items.description: One position's rendered thumbnail from Artifex's getDesign response.

thumbnails_pending.description: The picked design's preview is still rendering and may not become available: call `design_status` for it later, and never promise the user that it will appear.

anyOf.description:
Canonical short-circuit response shape.

`status` is always `"error"` — acts as a discriminator for LLM consumers.
`error` is a machine-readable code (e.g. `session_not_found`).
`reason` is a human-readable explanation of why the call failed.
`detail` carries structured extra context (ids, available values, etc.).

title: Pick a design candidate
